reuse.why: Replaces the three copied category queries with one shared MONTH_ACTION_CATEGORIES_QUERY used by four actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own JS version of the rule.

duplication.why: Removes three query copies; the eligibility rule is still stated twice (SQL constant and copyPreviousMonth's hidden/goal_def checks).

placement.why: Selection stays in budget/actions.ts beside the actions and getBudgetData.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, getBudgetData's selected columns and tests.

maintainability.why: A later rule change must touch both the SQL constant and copyPreviousMonth's checks, though both are close together and commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth reads budget rows rather than categories, so it applies the rule itself; the other actions use the shared query.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-states the SQL constant's hidden/group-hidden/goal_def conditions as JS checks on the budget rows (same rule reshaped from SQL into JS).

one_place.where: MONTH_ACTION_CATEGORIES_QUERY in budget/actions.ts for setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg, plus a separate hidden/goal_def check in copyPreviousMonth.
